evidence.field: 形義通解；甲骨文及金文用例
evidence.text: The entry reports four oracle-bone forms: 日+月, interpreted by Xu Zhongshu as the sun rising while the moon remains, hence dawn; 月+囧, with 囧 also phonetic and depicted as a lattice window, interpreted as moonlight entering a room; 目+月, with the oracle-bone examples too fragmentary to confirm as 明; and 田+月, where 田 may be a corruption of 日 or 囧. It says oracle-bone examples include dawn in 合集481 (‘乙巳明雨’) and brightness in 合集21037 (‘不喪朙’). Bronze examples include dawn in 大盂鼎, and ‘clear/manifest’ uses in other inscriptions. The entry reports that the Qin Shuihudi manuscript’s 目-form was judged by Qiu Xigui to be a corruption of 囧. It separately records 明 borrowed for ‘next’ in a Tsinghua manuscript and as a loan for 盟 in Houma covenant texts. These are source-reported readings and interpretations; the underlying inscription images were not inspected here.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — 明
